definitions.explanation: A symbol shaped like an arrow (→, ←, ↑, ↓) used to indicate direction or flow. Commonly seen on signs, maps, diagrams, and screens.

examples.japanese: {矢印|やじるし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{右上|みぎうえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{矢印|やじるし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An arrow is displayed in the upper right of the screen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{矢印|やじるし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}きます→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: If you turn in the direction of the red arrow, you'll reach the station.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers to arrow-shaped symbols used for indicating direction, not actual arrows used as weapons (those are ⟦{矢|や}→矢：10461_ya⟧). Commonly encountered on road signs, in documents, and on digital interfaces.

WRITING:
⟦{矢|や}→矢：10461_ya⟧ means "arrow" and ⟦{印|しるし}→印：03254_shirushi⟧ means "mark" or "sign." The compound literally means "arrow mark."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {矢印|やじるし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow an arrow
- {矢印|やじるし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦クリックする→クリックする：24722_kurikkusuru⟧: to click an arrow
- {矢印|やじるし}⟦キー→キー：10869_kii⟧: arrow key
